acceptance_criteria.criterion: AvaloniaThumbnailViewerService.ShowAsync opens ThumbnailViewerWindow as a modeless window and awaits close.
CloseAsync closes the window from any thread via Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync.
Calling CloseAsync when no window is open is a no-op (no exception).
dotnet build -c Release reports zero warnings.
ShowAsync constructs and shows a modal 800x600 window with ThumbnailViewerView as content.
CloseRequested event causes the window to close.
The event handler is always unsubscribed (no memory leak) — try/finally pattern.

summary: Implemented AvaloniaThumbnailViewerService following the established sub-VM dialog service pattern (modal window, try/finally unsubscribe).
Created ThumbnailViewerView.axaml + code-behind (DockPanel with compiled bindings, position header, image centre, navigation bottom toolbar).
Build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. All 413 tests pass.

Note: Ledger ACs reference 'modeless window' and 'CloseAsync' which conflict with both the WP spec file and the pre-existing IThumbnailViewerService interface docstring ('modal window'). Implemented the modal + CloseRequested-event pattern consistent with the spec, the interface, and the AvaloniaMoviePropertiesService precedent.

comments.note: Ledger acceptance criteria for WP-021 describe a 'modeless window' with 'CloseAsync(Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync)' pattern, which conflicts with the pre-existing IThumbnailViewerService interface (docstring says 'modal'), the WP spec file, and the AvaloniaMoviePropertiesService precedent. QA should verify this interpretation is correct; if modeless + CloseAsync is truly required the IThumbnailViewerService interface would need a CloseAsync() method added.

CancellationToken parameter in ShowAsync is accepted but not forwarded to ShowDialog. This is consistent with the AvaloniaMoviePropertiesService precedent and the WP spec does not require CT cancellation of the dialog. Low-risk.

If ThumbnailViewerViewModel is constructed with an empty list, Current returns null and the compiled bindings to Current.Bitmap and Current.PositionLabel will silently produce null/empty output in Avalonia. No crash expected, and empty-list handling is outside the scope of WP-021.
